rappel_detail.anchor: natural: slung horn or rock thread
rappel_detail.station: Just below the true summit, at the top of the roughly 150-ft cliff band on the east side.
rappel_detail.notes: First of two rappels down the cliff band, which early parties found uncomfortable to downclimb.

rappel_detail.anchor: natural: slung horn or rock thread
rappel_detail.station: Partway down the cliff band, at the end of the first rappel.
rappel_detail.notes: Second rappel, to the Class 2-3 slope above the snow finger. A single 60 m rope handles both.

set.rappels: 2 rappels down the roughly 150-ft cliff band below the summit, on a single 60 m rope
set.rappel_count_note: Two rappels down the roughly 150-ft cliff band just below the summit, from natural anchors. Individual lengths are not published.
set.descent: Reverse the ascent: rappel the cliff band below the summit, downclimb the Class 2-3 slope and the snow finger, recross the bergschrund, and descend the pocket glacier.
